name: Incentive Honorarium to Parents of Permanent Residents of Madhya Pradesh who enroll their Daughter in Defence Services
benefit: **Annual Honorarium:** - ₹20,000 per year is granted to the parents whose daughters are serving or have retired from the defense services. **Mode of Disbursement:** - The sanctioned amount is directly credited to the beneficiary’s bank account through the District Sainik Welfare Office.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be the mother or father of a daughter serving or retired from any recognized defense service (Army, Navy, or Air Force). 1. The applicant’s daughter must be serving in a recognized defense unit or retired not more than five years ago.
